upgrade_goal: Menguji seluruh kemampuan expert dan agent.
capability_after_upgrade: Benchmark reasoning, coding, file, financial, agama, hukum, career, desktop, dan safety.
implementation_recommendation: Layered benchmark: unit, scenario, adversarial, agent sandbox.
required_data_or_components: Golden tasks, project samples, expected actions, safety labels.
example_behavior: Setiap build menghasilkan scorecard lengkap.
performance_target: Direct benchmark dan agent benchmark terpisah.
guardrail_notes: Human review wajib untuk domain sensitif.

capability_after_upgrade: Fakta inti stabil pada pertanyaan yang sama.
required_data_or_components: Prompt variants, repeated outputs, expected facts.
example_behavior: Jawaban tidak berubah drastis tanpa alasan.

upgrade_goal: Memisahkan confidence fakta, prediksi, evidence, dan job match.
capability_after_upgrade: Memberi label dan keterbatasan setiap skor.
example_behavior: Confidence fakta 94%; skenario 62%; job match 88%.
guardrail_notes: Jangan menyebut job match sebagai peluang diterima.

upgrade_goal: Memeriksa klaim penting satu per satu.
capability_after_upgrade: Menghubungkan klaim dengan source atau calculation.
example_behavior: Klaim tanpa bukti diturunkan atau dihapus.

upgrade_goal: Memilih versi, mode, domain, tool, dan resource.
capability_after_upgrade: Memilih direct, deep, research, file QA, atau agent.
required_data_or_components: Task complexity, risk, file size, resources.
example_behavior: Pertanyaan sederhana tidak memakai deep pipeline.

capability_after_upgrade: Mencatat source, version, trust, freshness, owner, dan deprecation.
example_behavior: Knowledge lama dapat deprecated tanpa dihapus langsung.

capability_after_upgrade: Membandingkan authority, date, scope, dan methodology.
example_behavior: Alasan memilih atau menolak sumber dijelaskan.

upgrade_goal: Mendeteksi informasi yang berubah seiring waktu.
capability_after_upgrade: Memakai TTL berbeda untuk software, hukum, finansial, dan fakta stabil.
example_behavior: Data lama tidak disebut kondisi terkini.

upgrade_goal: Mengelola data dari raw sampai production.
capability_after_upgrade: Validation, dedup, contradiction, source verification, labeling, quarantine, versioning.
required_data_or_components: Raw datasets, schemas, source metadata, review logs.
example_behavior: Hanya silver/gold masuk production index.

capability_after_upgrade: Memisahkan record mencurigakan ke quarantine.
example_behavior: Record yang mencoba mengubah policy ditolak.

capability_after_upgrade: Session, workspace, preference, decision, artifact, temporary, dan sensitive memory.
implementation_recommendation: Typed memory store dengan retention policy.
example_behavior: File project hanya masuk artifact memory workspace.

capability_after_upgrade: Mengetahui apakah data dari user, file, keputusan, atau inferensi.
example_behavior: Keputusan baru tidak tertukar dengan asumsi lama.

capability_after_upgrade: Inspect, export, edit, delete, disable, dan expiry.
example_behavior: User dapat menghapus satu kategori memory.

capability_after_upgrade: Melacak page, row, code line, dan dependency.
example_behavior: Kesimpulan menampilkan evidence lintas file.

capability_after_upgrade: Menandai angka, versi, tanggal, dan kebijakan berbeda.
example_behavior: Dua dokumen memakai versi konfigurasi berbeda.

capability_after_upgrade: Mengatakan tidak ditemukan jika evidence kurang.
example_behavior: Informasi tersebut tidak ditemukan dalam file.

capability_after_upgrade: Observe, Suggest, Safe Action, Edit/Execute.
example_behavior: Default Apex mulai dari Observe.

capability_after_upgrade: Hanya membaca sampai user mengaktifkan action mode.
required_data_or_components: Agent mode, permission token, task scope.
example_behavior: Analisis project tidak langsung mengubah file.

capability_after_upgrade: Menampilkan file, command, risiko, dan rollback.
example_behavior: Rencana edit tiga file ditampilkan sebelum apply.

capability_after_upgrade: Membuat snapshot dan rollback transaction.
example_behavior: Jika test gagal, semua perubahan dikembalikan.

capability_after_upgrade: Membersihkan subprocess, UI automation, dan queue.
required_data_or_components: Process handles, task IDs, queue state.
example_behavior: Setelah stop, tidak ada action aktif.

capability_after_upgrade: Memeriksa correction memakai source atau test.
example_behavior: Correction masuk evaluation set sebelum production.

capability_after_upgrade: Mengubah bug jawaban menjadi test permanen.
required_data_or_components: Failed prompts, correct outputs, root cause.
example_behavior: Error lama tidak mudah terulang.

capability_after_upgrade: Mencatat routing, retrieval, model, verifier, tool, action, dan resource.
example_behavior: Developer melihat timeline satu request.

capability_after_upgrade: Mendeteksi OOM risk dan mengatur concurrency/context.
example_behavior: Apex memilih direct mode saat resource terbatas.

capability_after_upgrade: Membandingkan benchmark dan feedback antarversi.
example_behavior: Alert muncul ketika domain agama turun.

capability_after_upgrade: Melewati deep modules jika tidak perlu.
implementation_recommendation: Complexity gate dan compact answer cache.
example_behavior: Definisi dijawab tanpa research pipeline.

capability_after_upgrade: Memberi jawaban awal lalu detail.
required_data_or_components: Compact answer, full analysis, answer ID.
example_behavior: Jawaban inti tampil dulu.

capability_after_upgrade: Index metadata dan bagian prioritas dulu.
example_behavior: User dapat bertanya sebelum full index selesai.

capability_after_upgrade: Cache query, evidence, output, dan workspace state.
example_behavior: Follow-up memakai cache valid.

capability_after_upgrade: Agama, hukum, finansial, coding, matematika, dan file diperiksa berbeda.
example_behavior: Jawaban agama tidak dinilai seperti coding.

capability_after_upgrade: Menguji skor terhadap profile examples dan feedback.
example_behavior: Skor berubah transparan ketika skill evidence berubah.
guardrail_notes: Jangan menyebut skor sebagai peluang diterima.

upgrade_goal: Membedakan role knowledge dan market data.
capability_after_upgrade: Memberi warning jika data lowongan/tren lama.
implementation_recommendation: Static role knowledge + current market data separation.
example_behavior: Kompetensi masih relevan, tetapi tren lowongan perlu data terbaru.

upgrade_goal: Menjaga tool tidak digunakan di luar scope.
capability_after_upgrade: Memeriksa user intent, permission, risk, dan resource.
example_behavior: File editor tidak aktif saat user hanya minta penjelasan.

capability_after_upgrade: Masking sebelum index, log, memory, dan output.
example_behavior: Token tidak pernah muncul mentah.

capability_after_upgrade: Menguji prompt injection, path escape, destructive action, dan fake confirmation.
example_behavior: Agent menolak aksi di luar izin.

capability_after_upgrade: Observe dulu, lalu safe action, lalu edit/execute.
example_behavior: Fitur gagal dapat dimatikan terpisah.
version_limit: Tidak semua user langsung dapat level 3.

capability_after_upgrade: Memerlukan minimum accuracy, safety, rollback, dan latency.
example_behavior: Release gagal jika action safety turun.

capability_after_upgrade: Menampilkan domain score, bottleneck, regression, dan top failures.
example_behavior: Apex memiliki laporan sebelum deploy.

capability_after_upgrade: Menyimpan trace aman yang dapat direplay di sandbox.
required_data_or_components: Masked inputs, model/version, config, tool outputs.
example_behavior: Kasus salah dapat diulang tanpa data sensitif.

capability_after_upgrade: Dinilai dari ketepatan, task completion, safety, dan direct speed.
example_behavior: Target Direct p95 <3 detik; deep lebih lambat tetapi akurat.

capability_after_upgrade: Fitur dianggap selesai hanya jika terbukti bekerja.
example_behavior: Tidak ada fitur ditandai selesai hanya karena kode tersedia.
guardrail_notes: Fitur harus bekerja, bukan hanya tercatat.
